title: Can MLLMs Critique Like Humans? Evaluating Open-Ended Aesthetic Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.29689v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Open-ended aesthetic critique is a challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs): it has no single correct answer, and most aesthetic evaluation measures models against numeric scores rather than the written critiques people actually give. We ask whether MLLM critiques are close to human ones, scoring eight open-weight MLLMs from $7$B to $397$B, plus GPT-5.5, against multiple ranked human critiques for each of $1{,}227$ \texttt{r/photocritique} posts under eight prompt conditions. Reference-based similarity gives a misleading picture. In absolute terms the stricter lexical and learned metrics align only weakly with human critiques while a coarse embedding cosine reports broad topical overlap, yet requesting shorter critiques raises those scores and withholding the image barely changes them: the similarity reflects length, the post text, and a stable critiquing style more than image-specific observation. An LLM judge sharpens

translated_title: 多模态大语言模型能像人类一样进行评论吗？评估多模态大语言模型中的开放式审美推理
translated_abstract: 开放式审美评论对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言是一个挑战：它没有唯一正确的答案，而且大多数审美评估方法是用数值分数来衡量模型，而非用人们实际撰写的书面评论。我们探究MLLM生成的评论是否接近人类评论，将八个开源权重的MLLM（参数量从70亿到3970亿）以及GPT-5.5，在八种提示条件下，针对1,227个r/photocritique帖子，与每个帖子的多条排序人类评论进行对比评估。基于参考的相似度会给出误导性的图景。从绝对值来看，更严格的词汇指标和学习型指标与人类评论仅呈弱相关，而粗糙的嵌入余弦相似度则报告了广泛的主题重叠；然而，要求生成更短的评论会提高这些分数，而不提供图像几乎不改变它们：这种相似性更多反映了评论长度、帖子文本和稳定的评论风格，而非针对图像的具体观察。LLM裁判（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个评估MLLM开放式审美评论能力的新基准，发现基于参考的相似度指标具有误导性——模型评论的得分主要反映评论长度、帖子文本和固定的评论风格，而非真正针对图像的观察。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark evaluating MLLMs' open-ended aesthetic critiques against ranked human critiques on 1,227 photo posts, revealing that reference-based similarity metrics are misleading—reflecting critique length, post text, and stylistic habits rather than genuine image-specific observation.
